decision_rationale: The abstract describes a vision foundation model pretrained with masked image modelling on 72 million human cells. It also reports broad pretraining, zero-shot use, and a frozen encoder with transferable performance.
evidence_snippet: "pretrain a vision transformer by masked image modelling on 72 million human cells"; "use the frozen encoder with no fine-tuning"; "zero-shot evaluations"

decision_rationale: The abstract presents a new vision-language foundation model with self-supervised reconstruction and cross-modal alignment. It is pretrained on a large image-text corpus and evaluated across many tasks and datasets.
evidence_snippet: "self-supervised image reconstruction with text-guided cross-modal alignment"; "pre-trained on 207,957 image-text pairs"; "foundation model"

decision_rationale: This is a class-aware target-prioritization framework that uses the Evo2 foundation model as one input stream. The abstract does not present a new generative model.
evidence_snippet: "CrisPRO.ai developed a class-aware multi-modal target prioritization framework"; "using... the Evo2 genomic foundation model"

decision_rationale: SPgen is framed as a multi-modal foundation-model framework, but the abstract describes proteome-wide prediction rather than a clearly generative architecture. It does, however, claim transferable representations and broad applicability.
evidence_snippet: "multi-modal foundation-model framework for proteome-wide spatial protein prediction"; "learn transferable representations"

decision_rationale: The abstract introduces an ontology and latent-space communication protocol, not a generative model. Foundation models are discussed as background, but no candidate foundation model is actually presented.
evidence_snippet: "We introduce the Evolutionary Cell Ontology (ECO)"; "LSCP"; "a tool for auditing the biological knowledge a model actually contains"

decision_rationale: LLMBDC is a training-free framework that applies zero-shot LLM reasoning to cluster GO terms. The abstract does not describe a new generative foundation model.
evidence_snippet: "training-free framework"; "leverages zero-shot semantic reasoning of LLMs"; "cluster GO terms"

decision_rationale: MOSANIC is a new self-attention network for intercellular communication, but it is described as a predictor rather than a generative architecture. Its use of frozen foundation-model embeddings does not make the proposed model itself a foundation model.
evidence_snippet: "learns a tissue’s communication network"; "supervision is restricted to spatial gene-expression prediction"; "initialises every node with a frozen foundation-model representation"

decision_rationale: The abstract explicitly states that this is a review summarizing recent developments in AI-driven multi-omics for breast cancer. It is not a primary model paper.
evidence_snippet: "This review aims to summarize recent developments"; "key AI techniques, including ML and DL"
